title: gagea soleirolii subsp. nevadensis
intro: Gagea soleirolii subsp. nevadensis, commonly known as a species of flowering plant within the family Liliaceae, is a type of bulbous perennial. It is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The plant's therapeutic actions include its use in treating various conditions such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its expectorant and antiseptic properties. The bioactive constituents of Gagea soleirolii subsp. nevadensis include flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
